nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Developer guide to cert-manager's GNU Make tooling, covering target documentation conventions, .PHONY usage, prerequisite types, and automatic tool provisioning.

nodes.name: cluster.sh
nodes.summary: Creates or validates a local kind cluster for development, selecting a pinned node image per Kubernetes version and patching CoreDNS for example.com test domains.
nodes.languageNotes: Bash script with dynamic flag-to-variable assignment via eval and bash process substitution for Corefile comparison.

nodes.name: help
nodes.summary: Prints usage, flags, and environment variables for the kind cluster script, then exits.

nodes.name: setup_kind
nodes.summary: Creates the kind cluster if absent, then verifies kube context, API responsiveness, Kubernetes version, and CoreDNS Corefile, failing with remediation hints.

nodes.name: e2e-ci.sh
nodes.summary: Thin CI wrapper that runs the end-to-end suite through Make with two flake attempts, CI mode enabled, and kind logs captured on exit.

nodes.name: e2e.sh
nodes.summary: Runs cert-manager's Ginkgo end-to-end suite against an existing kind cluster, translating environment variables into ginkgo flags and emitting JUnit artifacts.
nodes.languageNotes: Documents a parallelism/performance experiment in comments and disables Ginkgo parallelism when focusing a test so logs stream.

nodes.name: help
nodes.summary: Prints usage, environment variables, and a worked example of reconstructing a Ginkgo test name for focused re-runs.

nodes.name: kind_images.sh
nodes.summary: Generated shell fragment mapping supported Kubernetes minor versions to pinned kind node image digests.
nodes.languageNotes: Sourced rather than executed; contains only variable assignments.
